fields.Name: T307 - Communication Providers Card Capabilities And Stats
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke provider-card composition: capability-flag chips derived from entity booleans plus per-provider 24h stats computed by client-side joining Communication Logs — not a grid or record form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Providers section. Success = provider cards render, each showing capability chips (e.g. Sending and Receiving with check/x marks, and possibly Scheduled/Drafts/Forward/Reply), a small stats row (Sent 24h / Success % / Failed), a Status badge (Active/Disabled), and Configure/Analytics footer actions — OR a valid empty state if no providers are configured. Wait for the section to load. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Provider cards render with capability chips and a 24h stats row (Sent / Success % / Failed), or a valid empty state
Each card shows a Status badge and Configure/Analytics footer buttons
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
